mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, query_name, query_config, export_fields, schema_version, sort_order, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted FROM ticket_saved_query WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_saved_query SET query_name = #{queryName}, query_config = #{queryConfig}, export_fields = #{exportFields}, schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, update_time = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
